Correctly signed descriptor/chunk fixtures distinguish full saves from raw changes despite valid commitments; do not use cross-language reserialization-byte equality as validity.
Versioned rules and signed differential vectors precede code; invalid carrier outcomes remain visible while valid checkpoint availability is preserved.

Core dependency graph and public API remain free of networking/storage/runtime/FFI; companion communicates through semantic core types.
Two independent processes exchange events and assert exact semantic state, selected control, heads and completion; no public relay is required for deterministic tests.
Restart/rebuild from evidence returns the same complete reference outcome; corrupted or incompatible caches cannot bypass core validation.
Crash matrix, concurrent writers, lost acknowledgements and restart tests show no lost authored event, duplicate actor sequence or accidental re-sign/re-author identity drift.
Fault-injected multi-relay tests converge when sufficient evidence arrives; incomplete evidence stays explicitly incomplete; cancellation preserves pending intent.
Fresh-process restore reproduces history/heads/digest; snapshot alone is not trusted history; stale/cloned actor restores cannot silently reuse an actor sequence.

All 19 directory contracts in EXAMPLES_CATALOG.md exist, are mapped to requirements and have working documented commands.
Catalog runner executes every required example in its declared lane; key values/heads/control/completion/errors are asserted, including packaged quickstarts.
A new contributor can follow these six using public APIs and local tools; each points to prerequisites, expected output and relevant failure cases.
Clean documented environment runs current lanes without private tools; wrapper argv/exit/error tests pass; historical receipts remain immutable.
